description: This file defines the SugarFieldParent class, a custom field type for the SugarCRM / SuiteCRM platform. It extends the SugarFieldRelate class and provides methods for rendering view templates (detail, edit, search views), handling import sanitization, generating quick search code, and retrieving search input values related to parent relationships within the CRM. The class customizes how parent relationships are displayed and interacted with in the CRM UI.

classes.name: SugarFieldParent
classes.description: A custom CRM field class for handling parent relationship fields, providing methods for rendering detail, edit, and search views, sanitizing imports, generating quick search JavaScript code, and processing search inputs.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the detail view for the parent field, with support for linking or not linking to related records.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the edit view for the parent field, including popup data setup and access key settings.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Provides the search view rendering for the parent field, supporting basic and advanced search modes.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes imported data by resolving related module beans based on vardef configuration.

methods.name: createQuickSearchCode
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for the quick search popup related to the parent field.

methods.name: getSearchInput
methods.description: Retrieves the user input value from search arguments for the parent field.
